ctaHeading: Get Your Home Maintained in Taylors Lakes
aboutText: With over a decade of experience since 2014, TLC Domestic Home Maintenance proudly serves Taylors Lakes and Melbourne's west. We began by addressing the needs of NDIS and aged care clients who were often overlooked. Our commitment is to deliver high-quality home maintenance services to everyone, treating each customer with fairness and respect. As we continue to grow, we aim to extend our services across Victoria and beyond.
servicesText: From minor repairs to major maintenance, TLC Domestic Home Maintenance covers a wide range of services for homes and businesses in Taylors Lakes. We specialise in NDIS and aged care support, ensuring accessibility and comfort. Our team is equipped to handle various tasks efficiently and professionally.
